name: GP Wood Products - Talladega Lumber Mill - Talladega AL

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to GP's Talladega lumber facility at 400 Ironaton Cutoff Rd, Talladega AL (~33.44459,-86.059685). The roster's geocoded point (33.4359,-86.1058, APPROXIMATE, movedMeters 11764) was ~4.6 km W in downtown Talladega and wrong. Mill complex centroid locked at 33.44400,-86.06000.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site has a continuous chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed all around in Street View 2025-11) with a single controlled entrance driveway off Ironaton Cutoff Rd. Loaded log trucks queue internally at a check-in. A barrier arm was not clearly resolved but the fenced perimeter with one defined truck entrance qualifies as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small red-roofed structure sits beside the inbound truck check-in lane, consistent with a scale house / gate office for a mill that takes ~150 log trucks/day. Flagged uncertain because the booth function is inferred.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a guard/scale house is present.
fieldNotes.scale: Lumber mill receiving ~150 log trucks/day; log trucks must be weighed in and out. A truck scale sits on the inbound truck path near the red-roofed scale house.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Log trucks pass an entrance gate then a scale/check-in before proceeding to the log yard — a two-stage process. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck approach from the gate to the log yard; loaded log trucks observed queued single-file.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gravel/paved truck yard with ample unused width to add a bypass or express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Receiving (log yard, SE) and shipping (lumber load-out / rail near the kilns on the W side) are physically separate operations.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Sawmills load finished lumber bundles by forklift from open sheds rather than truck-height dock doors; a few shipping bays may exist. Banded 0-10; low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No marked trailer-parking stalls; the yards hold logs and stacked lumber, not parked trailers.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW edge of the property with a spur curving into the mill near the kiln / lumber load-out area.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Multiple connected mill structures (sawmill, planer, kilns, storage sheds) — counted ~6 distinct buildings; treated as one facility.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural and wooded but only ~5 km from Talladega with other industry nearby; cellular coverage likely adequate. Marked false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Isolated mill surrounded by woods, a lake, and farmland — clearly Rural.

citations.claim: GP completed new $100M lumber facility in Talladega; ~130 jobs, 230M bd-ft/yr

verification.rationale: GP closed the old 1975 mill in 2016 then built a NEW $100M sawmill on-site (startup 2018) which GP operates today. Replaced asset, same site.
